characters.name: Gjertrud
characters.description: Gjertrud is a woman with a determined expression, wearing a distinctive red hat, symbolizing her stubborn nature. She is depicted in her kitchen, which might be filled with the rustic charm of the period. Her attire is simple, likely reflecting rural life. Her frustration is palpable as she attempts to bake lefses—thin, round Norwegian flatbreads—that become larger than intended.

characters.name: Gjertrudsfuglen
characters.description: Gjertrudsfuglen is Gjertrud's transformed state, a bird with a striking red crest, hinting at her previous red hat. Her body is entirely blackened, reflecting the soot from the chimney in which she transformed and escaped. She is often depicted flying through wooded areas, constantly pecking at trees, seeking food. Her beak is poised to peck, and she is shown amidst raindrops, symbolizing her eternal thirst, only quenched by rain.
